title: Inlet fill timeout
shortDescription: Tub did not fill in the allowed time.
fullDescription: LG washer-dryer combos display IE when the inlet valve cannot fill the tub fast enough. Closed taps, kinked hoses, or a clogged inlet screen are the typical causes.

fixSteps.title: Open taps
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm hot and cold taps fully open.

fixSteps.title: Straighten hoses
fixSteps.instruction: Pull unit out and remove kinks.

fixSteps.title: Clean screens
fixSteps.instruction: Unscrew hose ends and rinse the screens.

whenToCallPro: Service if IE returns with screens clear.
videoSearchQuery: LG washer dryer combo IE fix

faq.a: Yes, below 20 psi often triggers IE.

title: Drain timeout
shortDescription: Tub did not empty in the allowed time.
fullDescription: OE indicates the pump cannot empty the tub. Lint clogs, debris in the filter, or a failed pump are typical causes.

fixSteps.title: Drain via hose
fixSteps.instruction: Use the small drain hose at front-bottom.

fixSteps.title: Clean filter
fixSteps.instruction: Unscrew the debris filter and clean lint and coins.

fixSteps.title: Replace pump
fixSteps.instruction: Replace the drain pump if needed.

whenToCallPro: Call if pump replacement seems too involved.
videoSearchQuery: LG washer dryer combo OE drain

title: Unbalanced load
shortDescription: Tub cannot reach spin due to imbalance.
fullDescription: UE indicates the load is too unbalanced for safe spin. Bunched bedding, heavy single items, or worn shocks are typical.

fixSteps.title: Redistribute
fixSteps.instruction: Open door and rearrange the load.

fixSteps.title: Level unit
fixSteps.instruction: Adjust feet so the unit is rock solid.

fixSteps.title: Replace shocks
fixSteps.instruction: Replace shocks if drum bounces excessively.

faq.a: Sheets clump on one side, throwing off balance.

title: Door not locked
fullDescription: dE indicates the lock cannot engage or the door switch reads open. Inspect the catch and lock.

fixSteps.title: Clean catch
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe the door catch and strike.

whenToCallPro: Call if boot clamp removal is daunting.

faq.a: Drain via small front hose, then pull the manual release.

title: Motor locked
shortDescription: Drive motor cannot rotate the drum.
fullDescription: LE indicates the direct-drive motor is mechanically blocked or its hall sensor failed. Foreign objects in the tub or a failed rotor sensor are typical.

fixSteps.title: Unload
fixSteps.instruction: Remove all clothes and inspect drum.

fixSteps.title: Inspect inside boot
fixSteps.instruction: Run a hand around the rear of drum lip for objects.

fixSteps.title: Service motor
fixSteps.instruction: If LE persists, the rotor sensor or motor needs service.

whenToCallPro: Call if motor service is required.

title: Dryer thermistor fault
shortDescription: Dryer temperature sensor reads out of range.
fullDescription: tHE indicates the dryer temperature sensor is open or shorted. Drying programs are blocked until repaired.

fixSteps.title: Clean lint filter
fixSteps.instruction: Pull and rinse the lint filter.

fixSteps.title: Run condenser clean
fixSteps.instruction: Run the auto condenser cleaning program.

whenToCallPro: Call if you cannot reach dryer ducting.

title: Overfill
fullDescription: FE indicates the tub overfilled, often due to a stuck inlet valve or a failed pressure sensor. The pump runs continuously to drain and protect.

fixSteps.title: Replace pressure sensor
fixSteps.instruction: If FE persists with valve replaced, swap pressure sensor.

whenToCallPro: Call if you do not feel safe behind the unit.

faq.q: Why is water still coming in?
faq.a: A stuck-open inlet valve cannot be controlled by the board.

title: Pressure sensor fault
shortDescription: Water level pressure sensor signal abnormal.
fullDescription: PE indicates the pressure sensor or hose to the tub is blocked or out of calibration. Cycles may stall mid-fill.

fixSteps.title: Inspect hose
fixSteps.instruction: Pull the clear pressure hose and rinse the trap.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Replace the pressure sensor at the top of the chassis.

whenToCallPro: Call if top panel removal is daunting.

faq.a: Possibly; the unit pauses to be safe.

title: Motor over-current
fullDescription: CE indicates the inverter cut motor power because of an over-current event. Foreign objects, short in motor windings, or inverter failure are typical.

fixSteps.title: Unload
fixSteps.instruction: Empty the drum and check for foreign objects.

fixSteps.title: Service inverter
fixSteps.instruction: If CE returns, the inverter or motor needs service.

whenToCallPro: Most owners should call a tech.
videoSearchQuery: LG combo CE motor over current

faq.q: Will running it again damage motor?
faq.a: Yes, repeated CE may damage windings.

title: Clutch fault
fullDescription: E6 indicates the clutch on direct-drive motors did not engage during spin. Worn splines, broken clutch, or failed sensor are typical causes.

fixSteps.title: Service clutch
fixSteps.instruction: Tech inspects clutch and replaces as needed.

whenToCallPro: Most owners should call a service tech.

faq.a: Sometimes yes, but spin is degraded.
